files.hooks/open.ts:
export const LINUX_LAUNCH = 'setsid -f -w "$@" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & p=$!; sleep 1; kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; wait "$p"'

export const LINUX_OPEN = [
  'set -f',
  'f=$1',
  'if command -v gio >/dev/null; then',
  '  if [ -f "$f" ] && command -v file >/dev/null && encoding=$(file -b --mime-encoding -- "$f") && [ -n "$encoding" ] && [ "$encoding" != binary ]; then',
  '    case $(gio info -a standard::content-type -- "$f" | sed -n \'s/.*standard::content-type: //p\') in',
  '      video/* | audio/*)',
  '        app=$(xdg-mime query default text/plain)',
  '        IFS=:',
  '        for dir in "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}" ${XDG_DATA_DIRS:-/usr/local/share:/usr/share}; do',
  '          [ -n "$app" ] && [ -f "$dir/applications/$app" ] && exec gio launch "$dir/applications/$app" "$f"',
  '        done',
  '        echo "No text/plain desktop application found for $f" >&2',
  '        exit 1',
  '        ;;',
  '    esac',
  '  fi',
  '  if (exec gio open "$f"); then exit 0; fi',
  'fi',
  'exec xdg-open "$f"',
].join('\n')

const WIN_OPEN = "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; [Diagnostics.Process]::Start([Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]@{ FileName = $env:PANE_OPEN_TARGET; UseShellExecute = $true }) | Out-Null"

const WEB_SCHEMES = ['https:', 'http:']

export function openCommand(os: 'linux' | 'darwin' | 'win32', target: string) {
  const argv = os === 'linux'
    ? ['sh', '-c', LINUX_LAUNCH, 'sh', 'sh', '-c', LINUX_OPEN, 'sh', target]
    : os === 'darwin'
      ? WEB_SCHEMES.some(s => target.toLowerCase().startsWith(s))
        ? ['sh', '-c', 'open -a "Google Chrome" -- "$1" 2>/dev/null || open -- "$1"', 'sh', target]
        : ['open', '--', target]
      : ['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', WIN_OPEN]
  return {
    argv,
    init: {
      timeoutMs: 10_000,
      ...(os === 'win32' ? { env: { PANE_OPEN_TARGET: /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i.test(target) ? target : target.replace(/\//g, '\\') } } : {}),
    },
  }
}

{
  "name": "fabric-cli",
  "version": "26.40.3",
  "description": "Fabric and the Power BI service via the fab CLI, with a Fabric pane that follows fab.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Kurt Buhler",
    "url": "https://data-goblins.com"
  },
  "homepage": "https://data-goblins.com",
  "repository": "https://github.com/InsightfulAnalytics/PBI_Agentic_Dev",
  "license": "GPL-3.0",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "glyphs": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Glyphs",
      "description": "Icon set: auto uses FabricSymbols NF when it and a Nerd Font are installed and your terminal started after they were, else Nerd Font, else plain Unicode; Nerd Font over SSH, plain Unicode in the desktop app. Auto detection covers Linux and macOS; on Windows pick one to force it.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "fabric",
        "nerd",
        "plain"
      ]
    },
    "follow": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Follow Claude",
      "description": "on: the tree scrolls to what Claude reads, downloads, uploads or changes. off: the view stays where you put it and only your own scrolling moves it; highlights still show.",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "reportLinks": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Report links",
      "description": "embed: opening a report uses its reportEmbed link (app.powerbi.com/reportEmbed with autoAuth and the tenant). portal: the report page in the Fabric portal.",
      "default": "embed",
      "options": [
        "embed",
        "portal"
      ]
    },
    "fontHint": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Font hint",
      "description": "on: when auto icons fall back to plain Unicode, Claude is told once per session where to get the fonts. off: no hint.",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    }
  },
  "keywords": [
    "power-bi",
    "fabric",
    "fabric-cli",
    "fab",
    "semantic-model",
    "workspace",
    "lakehouse",
    "mod",
    "explorer"
  ]
}
